trio.note: Read as data only: inputs, saved registration, crop and zoom region.

segments.source: Chosen by inspection: along the chain of three beads at about [157.5, 133.5], [162, 130] and [165, 127.5] in the final image (upper left of the field), where G blurs the third bead into the haze.

offsetsXY.method: Displacement of the window [columns 148-175, rows 119-142] of the final image in each other image: background removed (minus a sigma-4 px Gaussian blur), peak of the normalized cross-correlation within +-6 px, parabolic sub-pixel refinement (peak 0.676 regular, 0.950 G).

panels.display: each crop linear from its minimum to its maximum

normalization: each profile divided by its own maximum
